mentions.name: TideCloak
mentions.description: An open-source Keycloak fork that keeps the familiar developer experience but changes the security model underneath, as part of a suite of tools to reduce how much sensitive data and privileged access apps keep concentrated in one place.
mentions.problem: Apps and infrastructure keep too much sensitive data and privileged access concentrated in one place.
mentions.audience: Software developers who need usable security tooling with a familiar developer experience
mentions.source_excerpt: One project is TideCloak, a Keycloak fork that keeps the familiar dx but changes the security model underneath: https://tide.org/tidecloak
